consistency.parameter_parity_decision: The source text labels gb odd, but this conflicts with its exchange relation: with odd kappa, gb*kappa must be odd to match [even b, odd a]. It also must be odd for commutation by b to preserve the CAR. This schema therefore records gb as even (parity 0), the unique choice compatible with both the stated relation and CAR. The source parity note is corrected in C_inhomogeneous_definition.md.
